verses.en: And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister; and said unto Jacob, Give me children, or else I die.
verses.pt: Vendo Raquel que não dava filhos a Jacó, teve inveja de sua irmã, e disse a Jacó: Dá-me filhos, senão eu morro.

verses.en: And Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel: and he said, Am I in God’s stead, who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb?
verses.pt: Então se acendeu a ira de Jacó contra Raquel; e disse: Porventura estou eu no lugar de Deus que te impediu o fruto do ventre?

verses.en: And she said, Behold my maid Bilhah, go in unto her; and she shall bear upon my knees that I may also have children by her.
verses.pt: Respondeu ela: Eis aqui minha serva Bila; recebe-a por mulher, para que ela dê à luz sobre os meus joelhos, e eu deste modo tenha filhos por ela.

verses.en: And she gave him Bilhah her handmaid to wife: and Jacob went in unto her.
verses.pt: Assim lhe deu a Bila, sua serva, por mulher; e Jacó a conheceu.

verses.en: And Bilhah conceived, and bare Jacob a son.
verses.pt: Bila concebeu e deu à luz um filho a Jacó.

verses.en: And Rachel said, God hath judged me, and hath also heard my voice, and hath given me a son: therefore called she his name Dan.
verses.pt: Então disse Raquel: Julgou-me Deus; ouviu a minha voz e me deu um filho; pelo que lhe chamou Dã.

verses.en: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.
verses.pt: E Bila, serva de Raquel, concebeu outra vez e deu à luz um segundo filho a Jacó.

verses.en: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.
verses.pt: Então disse Raquel: Com grandes lutas tenho lutado com minha irmã, e tenho vencido; e chamou-lhe Naftali.

verses.en: When Leah saw that she had left bearing, she took Zilpah her maid, and gave her Jacob to wife.
verses.pt: Também Léia, vendo que cessara de ter filhos, tomou a Zilpa, sua serva, e a deu a Jacó por mulher.

verses.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a son.
verses.pt: E Zilpa, serva de Léia, deu à luz um filho a Jacó.

verses.en: And Leah said, A troop cometh: and she called his name Gad.
verses.pt: Então disse Léia: Afortunada! e chamou-lhe Gade.

verses.en: And Zilpah Leah’s maid bare Jacob a second son.
verses.pt: Depois Zilpa, serva de Léia, deu à luz um segundo filho a Jacó.

verses.en: And Leah said, Happy am I, for the daughters will call me blessed: and she called his name Asher.
verses.pt: Então disse Léia: Feliz sou eu! porque as filhas me chamarão feliz; e chamou-lhe Aser.

verses.en: And Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them unto his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, Give me, I pray thee, of thy son’s mandrakes.
verses.pt: Ora, saiu Rúben nos dias da ceifa do trigo e achou mandrágoras no campo, e as trouxe a Léia, sua mãe. Então disse Raquel a Léia: Dá-me, peço, das mandrágoras de teu filho.

verses.en: And she said unto her, Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband? and wouldest thou take away my son’s mandrakes also? And Rachel said, Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son’s mandrakes.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe respondeu Léia: É já pouco que me hajas tirado meu marido? queres tirar também as mandrágoras de meu filho? Prosseguiu Raquel: Por isso ele se deitará contigo esta noite pelas mandrágoras de teu filho.

verses.en: And Jacob came out of the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, Thou must come in unto me; for surely I have hired thee with my son’s mandrakes. And he lay with her that night.
verses.pt: Quando, pois, Jacó veio à tarde do campo, saiu-lhe Léia ao encontro e disse: Hás de estar comigo, porque certamente te aluguei pelas mandrágoras de meu filho. E com ela deitou-se Jacó aquela noite.

verses.en: And God hearkened unto Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob the fifth son.
verses.pt: E ouviu Deus a Léia, e ela concebeu e deu a Jacó um quinto filho.

verses.en: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
verses.pt: Então disse Léia: Deus me tem dado o meu galardão, porquanto dei minha serva a meu marido. E chamou ao filho Issacar.

verses.en: And Leah conceived again, and bare Jacob the sixth son.
verses.pt: Concebendo Léia outra vez, deu a Jacó um sexto filho;

verses.en: And Leah said, God hath endued me with a good dowry; now will my husband dwell with me, because I have born him six sons: and she called his name Zebulun.
verses.pt: e disse: Deus me deu um excelente dote; agora morará comigo meu marido, porque lhe tenho dado seis filhos. E chamou-lhe Zebulom.

verses.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.pt: Depois. disto deu à luz uma filha, e chamou-lhe Diná.

verses.en: And God remembered Rachel, and God hearkened to her, and opened her womb.
verses.pt: Também lembrou-se Deus de Raquel, ouviu-a e a tornou fecunda.

verses.en: And she conceived, and bare a son; and said, God hath taken away my reproach:
verses.pt: De modo que ela concebeu e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Tirou-me Deus o opróbrio.

verses.en: And she called his name Joseph; and said, The LORD shall add to me another son.
verses.pt: E chamou-lhe José, dizendo: Acrescente-me o Senhor ainda outro filho.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Rachel had born Joseph, that Jacob said unto Laban, Send me away, that I may go unto mine own place, and to my country.
verses.pt: Depois que Raquel deu à luz a José, disse Jacó a Labão: Despede-me a fim de que eu vá para meu lugar e para minha terra.

verses.en: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have served thee, and let me go: for thou knowest my service which I have done thee.
verses.pt: Dá-me as minhas mulheres, e os meus filhos, pelas quais te tenho servido, e deixame ir; pois tu sabes o serviço que te prestei.

verses.en: And Laban said unto him, I pray thee, if I have found favour in thine eyes, tarry: for I have learned by experience that the LORD hath blessed me for thy sake.
verses.pt: Labão lhe respondeu: Se tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, fica comigo; pois tenho percebido que o Senhor me abençoou por amor de ti.

verses.en: And he said, Appoint me thy wages, and I will give it.
verses.pt: E disse mais: Determina-me o teu salário, que to darei.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Thou knowest how I have served thee, and how thy cattle was with me.
verses.pt: Ao que lhe respondeu Jacó: Tu sabes como te hei servido, e como tem passado o teu gado comigo.

verses.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came, and it is now increased unto a multitude; and the LORD hath blessed thee since my coming: and now when shall I provide for mine own house also?
verses.pt: Porque o pouco que tinhas antes da minha vinda tem se multiplicado abundantemente; e o Senhor te tem abençoado por onde quer que eu fui. Agora, pois, quando hei de trabalhar também por minha casa?

verses.en: And he said, What shall I give thee? And Jacob said, Thou shalt not give me any thing: if thou wilt do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep thy flock:
verses.pt: Insistiu Labão: Que te darei? Então respondeu Jacó: Não me darás nada; tornarei a apascentar e a guardar o teu rebanho se me fizeres isto:

verses.en: I will pass through all thy flock to day, removing from thence all the speckled and spotted cattle, and all the brown cattle among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats: and of such shall be my hire.
verses.pt: Passarei hoje por todo o teu rebanho, separando dele todos os salpicados e malhados, e todos os escuros entre as ovelhas, e os malhados e salpicados entre as cabras; e isto será o meu salário.

verses.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come, when it shall come for my hire before thy face: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the sheep, that shall be counted stolen with me.
verses.pt: De modo que responderá por mim a minha justiça no dia de amanhã, quando vieres ver o meu salário assim exposto diante de ti: tudo o que não for salpicado e malhado entre as cabras e escuro entre as ovelhas, esse, se for achado comigo, será tido por furtado.

verses.en: And Laban said, Behold, I would it might be according to thy word.
verses.pt: Concordou Labão, dizendo: Seja conforme a tua palavra.

verses.en: And he removed that day the he goats that were ringstraked and spotted, and all the she goats that were speckled and spotted, and every one that had some white in it, and all the brown among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.pt: E separou naquele mesmo dia os bodes listrados e malhados e todas as cabras salpicadas e malhadas, tudo em que havia algum branco, e todos os escuros entre os cordeiros e os deu nas mãos de seus filhos;

verses.en: And he set three days journey betwixt himself and Jacob: and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.pt: e pôs três dias de caminho entre si e Jacó; e Jacó apascentava o restante dos rebanhos de Labão.

verses.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar, and of the hazel and chesnut tree; and pilled white strakes in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.
verses.pt: Então tomou Jacó varas verdes de estoraque, de amendoeira e de plátano e, descascando nelas riscas brancas, descobriu o branco que nelas havia;

verses.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink, that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.pt: e as varas que descascara pôs em frente dos rebanhos, nos cochos, isto é, nos bebedouros, onde os rebanhos bebiam; e conceberam quando vinham beber.

verses.en: And the flocks conceived before the rods, and brought forth cattle ringstraked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.pt: Os rebanhos concebiam diante das varas, e as ovelhas davam crias listradas, salpicadas e malhadas.

verses.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked, and all the brown in the flock of Laban; and he put his own flocks by themselves, and put them not unto Laban’s cattle.
verses.pt: Então separou Jacó os cordeiros, e fez os rebanhos olhar para os listrados e para todos os escuros no rebanho de Labão; e pôs seu rebanho à parte, e não pôs com o rebanho de Labão.

verses.en: And it came to pass, whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive, that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.pt: e todas as vezes que concebiam as ovelhas fortes, punha Jacó as varas nos bebedouros, diante dos olhos do rebanho, para que concebessem diante das varas;

verses.en: But when the cattle were feeble, he put them not in: so the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.pt: mas quando era fraco o rebanho, ele não as punha. Assim as fracas eram de Labão, e as fortes de Jacó.

verses.en: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
verses.pt: E o homem se enriqueceu sobremaneira, e teve grandes rebanhos, servas e servos, camelos e jumentos.
